highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.1 incorporates focused Skia m150 fixes for rendering and corrupt text data.
highlights_body: This servicing release corrects stencil-area validation for clipped render passes and fixes cleanup ordering when malformed serialized Slug data cannot be decoded.

bullets.lead: Stencil clears validate clipped render-pass bounds
bullets.detail: The bundled engine checks clipped render-pass bounds against the cleared stencil area.

bullets.lead: Corrupt Slug cleanup is ordered safely
bullets.detail: Failed deserialization now releases the SubRunAllocator before freeing its backing memory, preventing invalid reads and frees.

v4.150.1.summary: Incorporates two focused fixes from the Skia m150 release line. Clipped render passes now validate their bounds against the cleared stencil area. Failed deserialization of corrupt Slug buffers also releases the SubRunAllocator before freeing its backing storage, preventing invalid reads and frees during cleanup.

harfbuzz_summary: Co-ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.1 as a package revision following 14.2.1.
